pages.text: $(italic)Melee DPS. Gets stronger as HP drops. The 'I don't need to dodge, I need to hit harder' class.$(/italic)$(br2)HP Modifier: -5%  |  Equipment HP: Normal$(br)$(bold)Weapon Affinities:$(/bold) Swords and axes (bonus), bows/crossbows (penalty)

pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Blood Fury$(/bold) — Below 40% HP: +20% melee damage, +10% attack speed. Below 20% HP: doubles to +40%/+20%. The core identity passive.$(br2)$(bold)Relentless$(/bold) — Each consecutive hit without taking damage: +3% damage, stacks to 10x (+30%). Taking damage removes 3 stacks.$(br2)$(bold)Bloodletting$(/bold) — Melee kills restore 2% max HP. Overkill damage increases this to 4%. Anti-synergy with Blood Fury — staying low vs healing up.

pages.title: Passive Abilities (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Thick Skinned$(/bold) — +10% armor effectiveness from worn armor pieces only. Compensates for -5% HP penalty.$(br2)$(bold)Battle Trance$(/bold) — After 10 seconds in combat: +5% all damage, -5% all damage taken. Rewards staying in fights.

pages.title: Active Ability
pages.text: Active: $(bold)Reckless Charge$(/bold)$(br)Dash 8 blocks, deal 150% weapon damage to first enemy hit, gain +25% attack speed for 4 seconds. During dash: +30% damage taken. 30s cooldown.
